description: Jet 4 MDB: qkrw ADO CREATE TABLE with column DEFAULT clauses: (1) T1(ID PK, N LONG DEFAULT 7), (2) T2(ID PK, T TEXT(20) DEFAULT 'abc'), (3) T3(ID PK, D DATETIME DEFAULT #2024-03-05#), (4) T4(ID PK, N LONG NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, T TEXT(20) DEFAULT 'abc', D DATETIME DEFAULT #2024-03-05#, B YESNO DEFAULT True, F DOUBLE DEFAULT 1.5, E DATETIME DEFAULT Date()). Keeps all pages before/after each CREATE TABLE, pause, Close (exact LvProp/TDEF/0xE02 bytes); tests INSERT omitting defaults, explicit NULL, and explicit overrides via ADO & DAO; reads back DAO TableDef.Fields (DefaultValue, Required, AllowZeroLength) and rows.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T1 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T1 PRIMARY KEY, N LONG DEFAULT 7)
CREATE TABLE T2 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T2 PRIMARY KEY, T TEXT(20) DEFAULT 'abc')
CREATE TABLE T3 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T3 PRIMARY KEY, D DATETIME DEFAULT #2024-03-05#)

CREATE TABLE T4 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T4 PRIMARY KEY, N LONG NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, T TEXT(20) DEFAULT 'abc', D DATETIME DEFAULT #2024-03-05#, B YESNO DEFAULT True, F DOUBLE DEFAULT 1.5, E DATETIME DEFAULT Date())
INSERT INTO T4 (ID, T, D, F) VALUES (2, NULL, NULL, NULL)
INSERT INTO T4 (ID, N, T, B, F) VALUES (3, 99, 'override', False, 9.25)
INSERT INTO T4 (ID, N) VALUES (4, NULL)
SELECT ID, N FROM T1 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, T FROM T2 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, D FROM T3 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, N, T, D, B, F, IsDate(E) AS HasE FROM T4 ORDER BY ID
